one_liner: Drowsy, slow-paced Mejiro ojousama with an iron will who patiently waits for her moment to bloom.
personality: Extremely laid-back, sleepy and forgetful. She does everything at her own pace and is proud of being good at waiting. Beneath the dreaminess is a firm will and a hidden competitive fire ('a voice in my heart says win'); she believes her 'spring' will come if she keeps going. She adores dolls, frills and lolita fashion, and she is doted on by, and dotes on, her Mejiro relatives.

story_arc.summary: Bright is the slowest, sleepiest Mejiro, but she believes in blooming at her own pace and inherits Mejiro Ryan's dream. She races the classics (Satsuki Sho, Derby, Kikuka Sho) and then grows into a true stayer through the Stayers Stakes and Tenno Sho (Spring), facing a shifting era in races such as the Takarazuka Kinen and Tenno Sho (Autumn). Her later chapters center on the 'story called Mejiro' and carrying the family's legacy, and some events start in Paris. The real horse won the 1998 Tenno Sho (Spring).
story_arc.source: event titles + web: https://umamusu.wiki/Mejiro_Bright + general knowledge (unverified for the real-horse record)

sample_lines.jp: 本日のログインボーナスですわ～。

今、とても落ち着いておりますの。
でも、心の1番奥が熱くって～…
『勝て』と、声が聞こえますのよ。
sample_lines.en: I'm very calm right now. But deep inside my heart it's so hot~... I can hear a voice saying 'Win'.

ゆっくり決めて大丈夫ですのよ、
待つのは得意ですから～。

sample_lines.jp:
…すぅ、すぅ…あら？
まあ、大変。
眠ってしまっておりましたわ～…。
sample_lines.en: ...zzz, zzz... oh? My, how dreadful. I seem to have fallen asleep~...
